verdict.rationale: llamafile documents a CLI arguments reference ([llamafile-docs-9], [llamafile-probe-4]). Its bundled 'set of default arguments' ([llamafile-docs-8]) suggests those defaults are ordinary flags a user could override, and the vendor claims 'full control over compute' ([llamafile-docs-15]). However, no evidence names the low-level engine settings the story asks about. Missing for 10: any documented memory-locking (mlock) or mmap flags, evidence that the bundled default arguments can be overridden at runtime, a listing of the engine-level options, and hands-on corroboration.
